release_read.basis: Q2 net sales +51% to $520.8m against a company guide of mid-30% growth, adjusted EPS $1.21 against Nasdaq's $0.37 forecast, FY27 sales guide raised to 22-24% from 18-20% and EBITDA to $421-427m; offset by a second-half guide of only 7-10% growth (Q4 below) and tariff-refund help, against a whisper 20% above consensus and a stock at its 52-week high.

key_line.detail: FY27 net sales growth raised to 22-24% from 18-20%; adj. EBITDA $421-427m from $401-407m; H2 growth 7-10% with Q4 below that range. Tariff refunds ~$55m for the year flatter margins.

guidance.detail: FY27 sales +22-24% (was 18-20%), EBITDA $421-427m (was $401-407m); H2 +7-10% implies a sharp deceleration, the part the bears will lean on

call.detail: Held last night; transcripts published (Benzinga, gloom.sh, tradingkey headline 'Sales Rise 51%, Outlook Raised'); content not read in the time available.

public_reaction.summary: Headlines lead with 51% sales growth and a raised outlook (tradingkey, Seeking Alpha); one gurufocus headline frames GAAP EPS $0.50 as a miss. No analyst actions searched for lack of time.

tape_read.note: Robust reference 118.18 = +4.0% vs prev close 113.63, against a frozen read of +6% and an implied move of 11.6%. After-hours +5.2%, pre-market high 122.84 (+8.1%) then sagged to 117-118: the early enthusiasm was sold. Stale: last print 08:58, 4 prints in the last 30 minutes, stale_at_open true. Entry 118.585, so the short is roughly flat (+0.2%). Market flat (SPY -0.05%, QQQ -1.1%).

thesis_check.note: The short rested on high expectations and a soft core brand; the quarter beat its own guide by a wide margin and the year was raised, which contradicts it, but the H2 7-10% guide and the pre-market sag from +8% to +4% show the bar was high, which partly supports it.

expected.open_lag_note: The pre-market is stale (last print 08:58) and already sagged from +8% to +4%, so the open is uncertain in both directions; an amc gap had all night to be read and gaps of this size usually give a little back by 10:00, while the raised guide argues against a deep fade.

recommendation.reason: De cijfers waren sterk (omzet +51%, jaarprognose verhoogd) en spreken de short-these grotendeels tegen; de koers staat voorbeurs ongeveer op de instapprijs, dus de positie is nu vrijwel vlak. Wachten op een terugval na de opening is een gok tegen een verhoogde prognose, en vasthouden tot het slot riskeert dat de markt het goede nieuws verder inprijst. Dek de short bij de opening, zoals de standaardregel voor amc.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Als de voorbeurskoers voor 09:30 actief terugzakt richting 115 of lager (de opleving van +8% verdwijnt verder), is een limiet-dekking rond 116 te overwegen in plaats van de opening.
